snippets.snippet_text: "Payhip wins on pricing accessibility. A $0 entry point with all features included is genuinely rare in ecommerce. Shopify offers more infrastructure at higher tiers, but for lean creator businesses, Payhip's model is the more affordable starting point."

"This is one of the clearest wins in the comparison. Payhip has built-in EU VAT and UK VAT handling for digital products. It collects and remits VAT automatically, and provides tax reporting to keep you compliant. For EU or UK-based creators selling digital goods, this removes a significant administrative burden."
